questions.prompt: Which language is an official language of Jamaica?

hints.nudge: An official language is the one used in schools, courts and government. The other three are spoken in other countries.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the “Language” part of the Jamaica article.

questions.proof: The official language of Jamaica is English and the population also speaks Jamaican Creole English.
